transcript.content: Hi, welcome in — I'm Dr. [Name]. To start, could you tell me what's been bringing you in today?

Hi Doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me. Um, well, I hope I explain this right, but... I've just been really, really motivated lately. Like, I can't seem to stop launching new projects. 

I've been drafting all these new work plans, setting up certification schedules, completely overhauling our home network... even messaging a bunch of old contacts. Which is a good thing, right? It's good to be productive. But, um... I guess it gets a little intense sometimes. I sort of... well, I guess I blow past normal limits, I suppose, until my wife or my director at work has to step in and tell me to slow down. I just get really focused, and they worry a little, which I feel terrible about. 

Is that... does that answer your question okay? I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need.
How long has this period of increased energy and drive to start new projects been going on—days, or weeks?

Well, um... I guess this specific kind of, you know, really driven period where I don't need much sleep and I feel like I can take on the world... it's been happening on and off for a little while now. 

I'd say roughly... maybe a year and eight months? Give or take? I mean, it's not like I'm always like this every single day, but these stretches have definitely been a part of my life for about that long. I hope that doesn't sound too bad. I just really want to be honest with you so we can figure this out. Is that the kind of timeframe you were looking for?
Have you ever gone through a separate period—lasting at least a couple of weeks—where you felt persistently down, low on energy, or lost interest in things you normally enjoy?

Um, yeah, I guess I have. I mean, I try really hard not to let it show, but... there are stretches where it happens. It's not that I'm ungrateful or anything, I have a great life, but... 

Sometimes I'll wake up and just feel like... like a failed version of myself, if that makes sense? It's just this really heavy, flat feeling. I don't want to make it sound worse than it is, but during those times, even just answering my wife's normal, everyday questions feels like it takes so much effort. Like it's just too much. 

I always try to push through it, though. I don't want to be a burden on anyone. Does that... is that the kind of thing you mean? I hope I'm explaining it right.

During those periods when you're feeling extremely driven and energetic, have you ever experienced things like hearing voices or seeing things others don't, or had beliefs—like feeling you have special powers or a special mission—that others found unusual or hard to believe?

Um... well, I really hope this doesn't make me sound crazy or anything, because I swear I'm usually very level-headed. But... yeah, I guess during those really intense times, when I'm barely sleeping and trying to push all those huge plans through... some strange things have happened.

I try to just ignore it, but... sometimes when I'm in the server room, it's like I can hear people making comments about me in the noise of the machines. Like, actual voices in the hum. And... I don't know, sometimes I'll read an email from a colleague and I'll be absolutely convinced there's a hidden threat in it. Like they're out to get me or sabotage my projects. 

I know it sounds bad when I say it out loud. I promise I don't act on it or yell at anyone, I just... I keep it to myself. I really don't want you to think I'm losing my mind. Is that... is that normal for people who get as stressed and overworked as I do? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.

Do these experiences—like hearing voices in the noise or feeling convinced people are targeting you—ever happen when you're not in one of those really high-energy or really low periods, like when your mood feels pretty normal and even?

Um... well... I guess, if I'm being completely honest... yes. Sometimes. 

I mean, I really try to just focus on my work and be a good manager, but... there have definitely been stretches where I feel totally fine. Like, my mood is completely even, I'm sleeping okay, not too high, not too low. Just... normal. But even then... 

Like, there was a period of a few weeks recently where I felt pretty calm, but I still... I still caught myself looking at people's Microsoft Teams statuses and feeling absolutely sure they were, like, coded warnings meant for me. And... I'd still hear those little comments sometimes when I was alone. Just brief things. 

I really hope that doesn't make things sound worse. I mean, I can still do my job and everything, I just... I want to make sure I'm answering your question right. Is it okay that I'm telling you this? I just want to be as helpful as possible so we can get this sorted out.
Thinking about the most recent few weeks, would you say you've been in more of a high-energy, driven state, or more of a low, flat, depressed state?

Um... actually, thinking about just the last couple of weeks... I don't think I've really been either? I hope that's okay to say. 

I've just felt... pretty normal, mood-wise. Not super sped up and running on no sleep, but not dragging or feeling flat either. Just kind of in the middle, going to work, managing the team... just doing what I'm supposed to do. I always try really hard to keep things balanced, so I guess I've been doing okay with that lately. 

Does that make sense? I hope it's alright that I don't have a big extreme to report right now. I just want to make sure I'm giving you the most accurate picture of how things have been.

During this recent stretch of a couple weeks where your mood has been steady, have those experiences—like hearing comments or feeling messages are coded warnings for you—been happening continuously throughout that whole time, or have they actually stopped?

Um... well... yes, they've still been happening. I mean, not constantly or anything! I don't want to make it sound like I'm completely distracted. But... yeah, during these last few weeks where my mood has been totally fine and steady... I've still been noticing those Teams statuses feeling like warnings. And... and catching those little comments when no one is around. 

It's happened before, too... like, there have been several stretches where I wasn't feeling too high or too low for a few weeks at a time, but those things were still going on. I really try to just push past it and do my job, and I promise it doesn't affect my work performance. I hope it's okay that I'm telling you this... I just want to make sure I'm answering correctly so you have all the facts. Does that... does that sound like the kind of thing you were asking about?
